def VTask.binaryRec : {motive : ℕ → Sort u} → (zero : motive 0) → (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) → (n : ℕ) → motive n := by
  intro motive zero bit n
  have h : ∀ (n : ℕ), motive n := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      match n with
      | 0 =>
        exact zero
      | 1 =>
        -- 1 = Nat.bit true 0
        exact bit true 0 (ih 0 (by decide))
      | n + 2 =>
        -- For n + 2, we need to determine the least significant bit and the remaining number.
        have h₁ : n + 2 = Nat.bit (if (n + 2) % 2 = 1 then true else false) (n + 2) / 2 := by
          have h₂ : (n + 2) % 2 = 0 ∨ (n + 2) % 2 = 1 := by omega
          cases h₂ with
          | inl h₂ =>
            -- Case: (n + 2) % 2 = 0
            have h₃ : (n + 2) % 2 = 0 := h₂
            have h₄ : Nat.bit false ((n + 2) / 2) = n + 2 := by
              have h₅ : (n + 2) % 2 = 0 := h₃
              have h₆ : Nat.bit false ((n + 2) / 2) = 2 * ((n + 2) / 2) := by
                simp [Nat.bit_eq_two_mul_add, h₅]
                <;> omega
              have h₇ : 2 * ((n + 2) / 2) = n + 2 := by
                have h₈ : (n + 2) % 2 = 0 := h₃
                have h₉ : 2 * ((n + 2) / 2) = n + 2 := by
                  omega
                exact h₉
              rw [h₆, h₇]
            have h₅ : (n + 2) / 2 = (n + 2) / 2 := rfl
            have h₆ : (if (n + 2) % 2 = 1 then true else false) = false := by
              simp [h₃]
            rw [h₆]
            have h₇ : Nat.bit false ((n + 2) / 2) = n + 2 := h₄
            have h₈ : (n + 2) / 2 = (n + 2) / 2 := rfl
            omega
          | inr h₂ =>
            -- Case: (n + 2) % 2 = 1
            have h₃ : (n + 2) % 2 = 1 := h₂
            have h₄ : Nat.bit true ((n + 2) / 2) = n + 2 := by
              have h₅ : (n + 2) % 2 = 1 := h₃
              have h₆ : Nat.bit true ((n + 2) / 2) = 2 * ((n + 2) / 2) + 1 := by
                simp [Nat.bit_eq_two_mul_add, h₅]
                <;> omega
              have h₇ : 2 * ((n + 2) / 2) + 1 = n + 2 := by
                have h₈ : (n + 2) % 2 = 1 := h₃
                have h₉ : 2 * ((n + 2) / 2) + 1 = n + 2 := by
                  omega
                exact h₉
              rw [h₆, h₇]
            have h₅ : (n + 2) / 2 = (n + 2) / 2 := rfl
            have h₆ : (if (n + 2) % 2 = 1 then true else false) = true := by
              simp [h₃]
            rw [h₆]
            have h₇ : Nat.bit true ((n + 2) / 2) = n + 2 := h₄
            have h₈ : (n + 2) / 2 = (n + 2) / 2 := rfl
            omega
        have h₂ : (if (n + 2) % 2 = 1 then true else false) = if (n + 2) % 2 = 1 then true else false := rfl
        have h₃ : (n + 2) / 2 < n + 2 := by
          have h₄ : (n + 2) / 2 < n + 2 := by
            apply Nat.div_lt_self
            <;> omega
          exact h₄
        have h₄ : motive ((n + 2) / 2) := ih ((n + 2) / 2) (by omega)
        have h₅ : (if (n + 2) % 2 = 1 then true else false) = if (n + 2) % 2 = 1 then true else false := rfl
        have h₆ : (n + 2) % 2 = 0 ∨ (n + 2) % 2 = 1 := by omega
        cases h₆ with
        | inl h₆ =>
          -- Case: (n + 2) % 2 = 0
          have h₇ : (n + 2) % 2 = 0 := h₆
          have h₈ : (if (n + 2) % 2 = 1 then true else false) = false := by
            simp [h₇]
          rw [h₈] at h₁
          have h₉ : bit false ((n + 2) / 2) (ih ((n + 2) / 2) (by omega)) = bit false ((n + 2) / 2) (ih ((n + 2) / 2) (by omega)) := rfl
          have h₁₀ : n + 2 = Nat.bit false ((n + 2) / 2) := by
            omega
          have h₁₁ : motive (n + 2) := by
            have h₁₂ : n + 2 = Nat.bit false ((n + 2) / 2) := h₁₀
            rw [h₁₂]
            exact bit false ((n + 2) / 2) (ih ((n + 2) / 2) (by omega))
          exact h₁₁
        | inr h₆ =>
          -- Case: (n + 2) % 2 = 1
          have h₇ : (n + 2) % 2 = 1 := h₆
          have h₈ : (if (n + 2) % 2 = 1 then true else false) = true := by
            simp [h₇]
          rw [h₈] at h₁
          have h₉ : bit true ((n + 2) / 2) (ih ((n + 2) / 2) (by omega)) = bit true ((n + 2) / 2) (ih ((n + 2) / 2) (by omega)) := rfl
          have h₁₀ : n + 2 = Nat.bit true ((n + 2) / 2) := by
            omega
          have h₁₁ : motive (n + 2) := by
            have h₁₂ : n + 2 = Nat.bit true ((n + 2) / 2) := h₁₀
            rw [h₁₂]
            exact bit true ((n + 2) / 2) (ih ((n + 2) / 2) (by omega))
          exact h₁₁
  exact h n
